name: rusalka-qwen-s31
prompt: A monochrome silverpoint character study: a single figure alone on plain off-white paper, drawn only in fine grey metalpoint lines and hatching. A thin, gaunt young woman, a malevolent spirit of the lake, dripping as if she has just risen from a swamp. Her very long, wet, straggling dark hair falls in heavy strands over her shoulders and down her front, so thick and tangled with leaves, weeds and swamp vegetation that it clothes her to the waist. A skirt of trailing water plants and wet leaves hangs loosely from her hips. A water lily blossom is tucked behind one ear. Her face is lean and angular, not a classical beauty, with a cold, luring expression. Full-length figure: the whole body from head to feet inside the frame, isolated on blank paper. silverpoint study, metalpoint drawing, bestiary illustration, hatching and cross-hatching, fine line, high contrast, sharp focus, monochrome, clean light paper ground
